title: Bitcoin Defends the 50-Day MA: Ultimate Trap or Reversal?
speaker: Nick Valdez

macro_themes.view: The 50-day crossing above the 200-day has marked the end of every past bear market, which suggests $58k was the bottom.
JPM Coin moving to Ethereum mainnet is good news for ETH.

calls.condition: A break higher still faces the descending trend line and the 50-day EMA
calls.reason: Rejected at the 50-day EMA with a liquidation magnet near 81.5k (possible near-term lower lows); a 50/200 golden cross historically ends the bear market, so 58k is the bottom.
calls.quote: this is suggesting 58K is the bottom for Bitcoin

calls.reason: Still respecting the floor of a 4h bull flag; chopping inside its range.
calls.quote: ETH's still chopping within its range

calls.reason: Holding the June 15 wick-high level; a flat 12h RSI near oversold has preceded pumps (one was 14%) the last three times.
calls.quote: XRP is repeating a pattern that's led to a little bit of pumps

calls.condition: Long now, adding near 1150 and 1100; a head-and-shoulders points below 1000 (technical target 400, which he doubts)
calls.reason: Long at about break-even and expecting a pop, but a possible head-and-shoulders could take it below $1,000.
calls.quote: with this head and shoulder pattern, I I easily see Zcash going below $1,000

calls.reason: Rising parallel channels usually resolve lower; watching the 10.80 level.
calls.quote: the probabilities dictate that the downside is going to be more likely than the upside

calls.condition: Could come down to support and bounce
calls.reason: The 4h support line held on Sunday's retest; likes a bounce from support.
calls.quote: I could definitely see Solana coming down and bouncing off of that range

calls.condition: If it keeps pumping, short near the 0.382 Fib / descending trend line
calls.reason: The descending trend line from Sep 25 lines up with the 0.382 retrace as resistance.
calls.quote: I'm looking to short Morpheus right around the 262 target

notes: Date taken as Mon 2026-10-19 ("Sunday afternoon" = yesterday). ZEC is mixed: he is long but describes a bearish head-and-shoulders. MOR short level "262" read as $2.62 (units unclear). NEAR (short on a breakdown/retest) and ADA (past 0.211 trade) skipped as minor.
